{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify unique patients
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check if any patient has more than one sample sequence (i.e., multiple rows)
duplicate_patient_rows = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Count the number of patients with multiple entries
multiple_entries_count = duplicate_patient_rows['patient_id'].nunique()

# Total number of patients (unique patient_id)
total_patients = unique_patients

# Print results
total_patients, multiple_entries_count"}
